question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Consensus for fiscal Q4 2026 diluted EPS is $1.99 (27 analysts), versus $1.85 a year earlier. Bottom-up from guidance (revenue +9-11% to about $112.7B, gross margin 47-48%, opex about $18.4B, tax about 17%, about 14.6B diluted shares) gives about $2.00. Apple has beaten consensus 8 of the last 8 quarters, typically by 4-7% (fiscal Q4 2025 1.85 vs 1.77; fiscal Q3 2026 2.02 vs 1.89, including a one-time $0.11 tariff refund). Supply constraints, rising memory costs and FX could cap the upside. So the median is shifted about 3% above consensus to about $2.05. A small low-side tail covers a one-time GAAP charge like the fiscal Q4 2024 EU tax charge (GAAP EPS $0.97). No Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market was found.

- Fiscal Q3 2026 (June quarter): revenue $109.4B (+16% YoY), diluted EPS $2.02 (+29% YoY) vs $1.89 consensus. That included a +$0.11 one-time tariff refund (~$2.19B) (Apple 8-K / VectorShift, Jul 30 2026).
- September-quarter guidance: revenue +9-11% YoY, including ~2.5pt FX headwind; gross margin 47-48% (vs 50.1% in Q3); iPhone growth mid-teens; supply constraints on advanced-node SoCs to 'increase significantly'; memory costs rising; mid-quarter Mac and iPad price increases (Digital Applied, Aug 2026).
- Bottom-up from guidance midpoint: revenue ~$112.7B x 47.5% gross margin = ~$53.5B gross profit; opex ~$18.4B (assumed); tax ~17%; ~14.6B diluted shares -> EPS ~$2.00.
- Apple beat consensus EPS in 8 of the last 8 quarters (MarketBeat). Example beats: fiscal Q4 2025 1.85 vs ~1.77; fiscal Q1 2026 ~2.84 vs ~2.67; fiscal Q3 2026 2.02 vs 1.89. Typical surprise +3-7%.
- Downside precedent: fiscal Q4 2024 GAAP EPS was $0.97 because of a one-time ~$10B EU State Aid tax charge (adjusted $1.64). One-time GAAP charges can occur in the September quarter.
- Quarter covers iPhone 18 Pro launch sales, Apple Watch Series 12 / Ultra 4 and AirPods 5. Analyst ratings in October: JPM Overweight, UBS Neutral.
- Searched for but not found: a Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on Apple EPS; Apple's exact opex and tax guidance figures; any announced fiscal Q4 one-time charge.
